# External interoperability fixtures

These files are committed so tests remain completely offline:

- `duckdb_geoparquet.parquet` is generated by DuckDB 1.5.2 from `generate_duckdb_geoparquet.sql`. It contains WKB, scalar columns, a nested struct, a list, and GeoParquet 1.1 metadata.
- `flatgeobuf_countries.fgb` and `flatgeobuf_poly00.fgb` are the `countries.fgb` and `poly00.fgb` fixtures from the [FlatGeobuf project](https://github.com/flatgeobuf/flatgeobuf/tree/master/test/data). They exercise successful indexed decoding and explicit rejection of an unsupported source CRS.
- `map_tile_16_17896_24449.mvt` is the gzipped real-world tile fixture distributed with [paulmach/orb](https://github.com/paulmach/orb/tree/master/encoding/mvt/testdata).

The generator is not run by the tests. Tests read the committed bytes directly.
